name: chapter_6
title: Introduction to Conjunctions
description: This chapter explains conjunctions (and, but, or, so, because, although, etc.) and how they are used to connect words, phrases, or clauses.

options.A: I like apples, and I like oranges.
options.C: I like apples, I like oranges and.
options.D: I like apples or oranges and.

questions.question: Which conjunction is used to show contrast?

options.A: She stayed home because it was raining.
options.B: She stayed home so it was raining.
options.C: She stayed home but it was raining.
options.D: She stayed home and it was raining.

questions.question: Which sentence shows cause and effect?

options.A: He was tired, so he went to bed early.
options.B: He was tired, but he went to bed early.
options.C: He was tired, although he went to bed early.
options.D: He was tired, and he went to bed early.
